upādāniyasutta:
[Upādāniya+sutta]  CL=9 1. First Upadaniya Sutta (SN 22.121):
- Teaches that the five aggregates (khandhas) are things that can be clung to (upadaniya)
- Defines attachment (upadana) as the desire and passion for these five aggregates
- In the Pali Canon, the Buddha uses the phrase "upadaniyesu dhammesu"
- The commentator (Tika) named it Upadaniya Sutta based on this usage
2. Second Upadaniya Sutta (SN 35.123):
- Explains that forms, sounds, etc. are things that can be clung to (upadaniya)
- Defines attachment (upadana) as the desire and passion for these sense objects
